prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel-art game spritesheet with true transparent RGBA background. Reference is a specific boss, preserve exact recognizable identity: stocky heavy brown-furred beast with short curved BLACK RAM HORNS, tawny/brown shaggy hair and beard mane, fierce fanged broad face, pointed ears, large clawed hands and clawed bare paw feet. Clothing must remain DARK FOREST GREEN cape with GOLD trim and small gold fleur-de-lis embroidery, gold round clasp, beige off-white shirt, dark torn charcoal trousers with brown patches and black belt/gold buckle, green/gold wristbands. Preserve all costume details, same face and anatomy across frames. Face LEFT throughout, mirror reference direction as needed. Dark fantasy detailed crisp pixel art like references. NOT a human/NOT a wolf/NOT a minotaur bull head; keep the supplied horned beast man's face. No white fringe/no checkerboard/no captions. EXACTLY EIGHT equal COLUMNS by SEVEN ROWS, 56 full-body drawings, each action 8 chronological DISTINCT poses: ready, prepare, windup, anticipation, strike peak, follow-through, recovery, ready. Stable body size, fixed feet baseline, generous TRANSPARENT gutters around cells and enough space for raised claws and jump; never crop horns/cape/paws. Eighth frame closes on row1frame1 ready stance.
Row1 idle: relaxed claws by side, subtle breathing and cape sway, never body size changes.
Row2 hurt: ready, flinch, lean backward RIGHT (boss faces LEFT), stronger recoil, peak recoil, regain footing, recover, ready.
Row3 double claw slash LEFT: ready, lift claws, draw one claw back, lean into attack, cross-cut both claws LEFT at frame5 with small WHITE claw streaks, retract claws, recover, ready.
Row4 roaring charge LEFT: ready, tense and open jaw, roar, brace forward, roaring shoulder lunge LEFT at frame5 with tiny GOLD impact spark near muzzle, follow-through, settle, ready. Keep movement inside cell modest, game moves the actor.
Row5 horn headbutt LEFT: ready, lower head, draw torso back, brace horns, thrust lowered horns LEFT at frame5 with small tan/gold impact and mud fragments, follow-through, raise head, ready.
Row6 DEFENSIVE GUARD (not attack/not heal): ready, raise forearms, claws curl, bring both forearms crossed protectively in front of beige shirt, full crossed-claw guard with subtle GOLD/olive protective aura, sustain, lower arms, ready. No projectile.
Row7 dedicated ultimate earthquake leap/slam LEFT: ready low crouch, deeper crouch cape gathers, leap with both clawed arms raised, descending windup both paws toward ground, peak two-handed slam LEFT at frame5 with local MUD/tan shards and GOLD/olive ground arc, recoil from impact, regain stance, ready. Same body and face as references, no giant duplicate beast. Independent ground-wave effect will be drawn by game. Entire figure visible in each cell, aligned row baselines.

Use case: stylized-concept. Premium dark-fantasy pixel-art VFX spritesheet, TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS in ONE ROW, 4 separate effects, wide transparent gutters/no text. For horned brown-furred beast boss of a swamp with forest-green and gold cape in reference. NO CHARACTER, NO BODY, NO HORNS/HEAD; draw only earth magic and muddy shockwave effects. Each effect standalone inside cell. Left-to-right cells: 1) small OLIVE-GOLD circular ground seal with three white claw marks and swirling brown mud specks, charge; 2) powerful rising tan/gold crescent of MUD and claw-shaped pale energy, striking LEFT, trailing gravel to RIGHT; 3) large volcanic-style burst of earth/mud slabs radiating UP from a circular ground impact, sharp tan-white/gold shock front with olive glow, NOT fire; 4) expanding gold/tan shock ring low to ground, mud and debris dissolving into dust. Crisp detailed game pixel art with transparent glow and dark brown outlines, no white border/checkerboard/background. Same reference palette of earth, pale claws, GOLD and muted moss-green. No bright blue/purple, no modern objects. Landscape sheet with each frame complete and uncropped.
